home.title: From a warehouse in Greater Vancouver to hospitals and schools in 65 countries.
home.lead: Since 1993, Rotary volunteers have rescued donated medical and educational equipment from across British Columbia and shipped it, one 40-foot container at a time, to communities that need it most.

calendar.title: Loadings, meetings and events.
calendar.lead: Loading days are the best way to see Rotary World Help in action. Loading dates depend on goods being available and on shipping bookings, so please confirm with us before you come.

contact.title: Come and see the warehouse.
contact.lead: Questions about donations, membership, aid requests or volunteering at a loading? We would love to hear from you.

countries.title: Every country, every container.
countries.lead: Choose a country to see the containers sent there, loading photos, stories, letters and videos.

directors.title: The people steering our efforts for global change.
directors.lead: Every director is a volunteer Rotarian, nominated by a member club. The Board meets an average of ten times a year.

donate.title: Two ways to fill a container.
donate.lead: Give money to cover freight, or give equipment to fill the container. Both go straight to communities in need, Rotary club to Rotary club.

get-involved.title: Remember: everyone can help.
get-involved.lead: Whether you are an individual, a Rotarian, a business, a school or a community group, there is a way to help the next container sail.

join.title: $10 per member. Every shipment, worldwide.
join.lead: For an annual fee of $10 CDN per member, your club becomes part of an organization that works with Rotary clubs worldwide to help communities help themselves.

member-clubs.title: A network of clubs, not individuals.
member-clubs.lead: Rotary World Help's members are Rotary clubs. Each pays $10 per member per year and together they make every shipment possible.

news.title: Stories from the warehouse and the field.

newsletters.title: News from the warehouse, in your inbox.
newsletters.lead: Read past newsletters and annual reports, or subscribe to hear about loadings, arrivals and events.

our-impact.title: What a container becomes when it arrives.
our-impact.lead: Hospital wards furnished, clinics equipped, classrooms supplied. These are the places our volunteers' work ends up, in the words and pictures of the people who received it.

our-story.title: It started with one stethoscope shared by eight doctors.
our-story.lead: Established in 1993 and sanctioned by Rotary International in September 1997, Rotary World Help provides medical and educational supplies to communities in need.

request-aid.title: Our only criterion for aid is need.
request-aid.lead: Rotary World Help gathers, sorts, records and ships 20- or 40-foot containers of medical, dental, optical, educational and sports goods to countries where people are in need, Rotary club to Rotary club.
